_comment: Power/resource baseline thresholds for Migo Android runtime. Metrics collected from Java-side instrumentation (Debug.getNativeHeapAllocatedSize, /proc/self/stat, BatteryManager). See CLAUDE.md section 11.1.

cpu_avg_pct.description: Average CPU usage during steady-state gameplay (from /proc/self/stat sampling)

cpu_peak_pct.description: Peak CPU usage observed during test run

memory_native_mb.description: Native heap allocation (Debug.getNativeHeapAllocatedSize) at steady state

memory_java_mb.description: Java heap usage (Runtime.totalMemory - freeMemory) at steady state

memory_total_mb.description: Total process memory (native + Java) at steady state

battery_drain_pct_per_hour.description: Estimated battery drain rate during active gameplay

audio_idle_cpu_pct.description: CPU usage when audio thread is in Sleep/LowPower state (validates power state machine)

thermal_throttle_events.description: Number of thermal throttling events observed during test
